_purpose: Records whose filing shows the adopted prior-year development figure to be a take-on: the reserves a loss portfolio transfer brought in, or an RITC premium. A take-on is not development. run_analysis.py (load_and_classify) tags such a record TAKEON_NOT_DEVELOPMENT when it would otherwise be reliable: the record stays in the corpus and is not modelled, the way a net-basis record is recorded and excluded, and the disposition ledger counts it in a step of its own. A syndicate-year in the RITC regime whose adopted figure is development stays in the sample. takeon_amount_m is the transferred amount the filing states, in millions of the report's own currency. The loader refuses an entry without two readings, its pages and a quote; an entry marked _to_complete is skipped, not applied, until it carries them.
